statement: Do conjunctive buried-contrast steps (min of percentile-ranked |grad depth_to_base_surf| and |grad iso_grav_anom|, low-relief arm) place emission on off-catalogue fault pixels better than a uniform-random emission of identical mass under identical masks, on the repository's two preregistered instruments?

construction: masked reads; sentinel nodata (-3.4028235e38) -> NaN; NaN inside footprint replaced by footprint median before gradients, invalid restored after
g_depth = |Sobel depth_to_base_surf| per px; g_grav = |Sobel iso_grav_anom| per px
g_depth, g_grav -> percentile ranks over footprint cells only, in [0,1]
conj = min(r_depth, r_grav)  (soft AND: both fields must be locally extreme)
gate = (slope_p90 <= 8 deg) AND (relief_local <= 25 m), thresholds fixed a priori from the topo pack's own p0.5-p99.5 ranges (41.82 deg, 80.54 m), label-free
primary arm field_h62 = conj * gate; ablation arm field_h62_ungated = conj

masks.striped_rows: gems60.surface.detect_striped_rows on streamed 19-band row means (z >= 4 in >= 2 bands)
masks.note: no playa mask: H62-1 targets under-cover steps including basin interiors, and the off-catalogue instrument's maximal-separation thinning deliberately spreads truth into basin floors; masking playas would delete potential true positives. This is a documented deviation from run_lane.py's confound list.

spatially_blocked_hideout.truth: catalogue hide-and-recover: whole components withheld, visible catalogue masked pixel-exactly at scoring

off_catalogue.population: SGMC fault pixels >= 300 m from the catalogue, maximal-separation thinned to the |G| mid pin 14088.7 (same pins as run_lane.py)
off_catalogue.use: budget choice ONLY (the instrument is prevalence-corrected, per src/gems60/holdout.py docstring) + the beats-random contrast

arms.h62_candidate: final emission raster (fixed), primary arm unless barred by the canary
arms.random_matched: uniform-random raster, same mass, same masks, seed 777
arms.field_topk_canary: raw field re-emitted per fold via gems52.holdout.emit_topk at the candidate's budget (label-free upper bound)
arms.champion: registry/rasters/dotted_b2_prune_02778.tif as-is (owner-reported live 0.2778; context only - different mass)
arms.d28: registry/rasters/dotted_d2_8_02600.tif as-is (owner-reported live 0.2600; context only - different mass)
arms.h274r1: registry/rasters/dotted_d2_8_02708.tif as-is (owner-reported live 0.2708; context only - different mass)
arms.h16topo: data/scored/gems16-h16-1-...-nan.tif as-is (owner-reported live 0.1855; context only - different mass)

budget_rule: emission budget = argmax of the ELIGIBLE primary arm's off-catalogue DTI over the ladder (preregistered instrument use: budget choice)

canary.rule: rank AUC vs the off-catalogue truth; any input with AUC > 0.90 is flagged; if the PRIMARY arm's field AUC > 0.90 the primary arm is BARRED and the ungated ablation arm becomes the candidate (preregistered fallback); if both > 0.90 the experiment stops NEGATIVE

gates.G0_surface_uniqueness: before placement: max |Spearman(field, registry raster)| <= 0.90 over a footprint subsample (>=400k cells) for every registry raster; FAIL => duplicate, stop
gates.G1_canary: candidate arm field AUC vs off-catalogue truth <= 0.90 (see canary rule)
gates.G2_beats_random: on the spatially blocked hideout, candidate pooled HOLDOUT-DTI > random_matched pooled HOLDOUT-DTI AND paired difference positive in >= 3 of 4 folds; on the off-catalogue instrument at the emission budget, candidate DTI > matched-random DTI
gates.G3_beats_holdout_best: candidate pooled HOLDOUT-DTI strictly greater than EVERY comparable arm in the pooled summary (the family's promotable bench 0.190147 lives on a DIFFERENT instrument and is cited, not compared)
gates.G4_dots_uniqueness: after placement: <= 70% of candidate dots within 3 px of ANY registry raster's dots AND max |Spearman| <= 0.90
gates.verdict_rule: PROMOTE (as a candidate for the separate selector step; this script never spends a slot) iff G0 and G1 and G2 and G3 and G4 all pass; otherwise NEGATIVE with the failing gates named. Negative results are deliverables.

honesty.evidence_class: HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator version + withheld positives + 95% CI reported with every number)
honesty.instruments_cannot_measure: the hidden test set; no local number is written as a leaderboard score
honesty.anchored_arms_note: anchor arms are scored as-is with their own mass; they are context, not matched-budget controls
